pullRequest.title: Pad fractional seconds when parsing datetimes
pullRequest.author: contributor-login
pullRequest.description:
Pads the fractional seconds of a datetime on the right with zeros, so `1979-05-27T07:32:00.5` parses with 500000 microseconds.

A time without fractional seconds still parses with 0 microseconds.
pullRequest.head: pad-fractional-seconds
